description: Use this when every inbound copy on an inbox should also go to an external address, such as a team mailbox or an archive. Requires auth and inbox_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), email (required), client_id (optional, 1–128 characters). Cooper emails a 6-digit code to that address only. The code is not stored in a Cooper inbox and is not returned. The human confirms it with POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/forwarding/confirm. Returns the destination with status pending (HTTP 202) or verified (HTTP 200 when it was already verified). The same client_id returns the original destination and does not send another code. An inbox stores at most 5 destinations (HTTP 409 forwarding_limit). That cap is technical and does not change Free, Starter, or Pro. The inbox itself, an address at cooperemail.com, and any Cooper inbox are HTTP 400 forwarding_target_not_allowed. Confirmation email is limited to 5 per hour per IP and 3 per day per address (HTTP 429 rate_limited). Actual forwards later use the send path and count toward the monthly send quota. rules forward_to is unchanged.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters. The same key returns the original destination and does not email another code.

email.description: External address that should receive copies after the human confirms. Not this inbox and not a Cooper inbox.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_request_forwarding

outputSchema.description: The destination after Cooper emails a confirmation code. The code is not included.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time a pending code expires, or null once verified.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

status.description: pending until the human confirms, or verified when it already was.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 time the address was confirmed, or null.

title: Request auto-forward confirmation
